mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates robust labor market conditions, driving corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS rises

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% signals a tight labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5%

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and rise in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a monetary easing cycle with strengthening supply, compressing equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines and INDPRO rises

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), a rising CPI (CPIAUCSL) signals persistent inflation, prompting central bank hawkishness and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL rises

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) reflects strengthening supply chains and manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when INDPRO rises

mechanism_narrative: A rise in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand for residential construction, boosting related sectors and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when HOUST rises

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in consumer spending (RSAFS) and declining unemployment (UNRATE) signals robust consumer confidence, driving demand for goods and services and producing positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when RSAFS rises and UNRATE declines

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates for equity cash flows and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%
